notes: Covers the 2011 Global Wash System line in Whirlpool Job Aid W10450109, which lists the WDT710PAY* (all colours) with the other WDT and WDF models. Its diagrams are typical of the line rather than one model, and it shows variants with and without a diverter valve.

gaps: Most ratings appear only in the circuit diagrams on job aid pages 83 and 85 to 87, which have no text layer; they were read from 150 to 300 dpi renders.
The job aid says its wiring diagrams are typical and for training only; the unit's own wiring diagram and Tech Sheet are the reference.
The job aid shows plastic and stainless tubs, models with and without a diverter valve, and the Powerscour manifold on some models; it does not say which applies to the WDT710PAY.
The control sticker in the page 83 photo reads S8.02.0 Skywalker, PRE-PILOT and W10352583; it is a pre-pilot sample, so W10352583 is not confirmed as a production part number.
The 120 V 60 Hz on page 83 is the appliance supply, not a rating printed for the control, so no voltage is set on the control board.
No part numbers are printed for the triacs, relays, fuses or any other part; none are claimed.
Tub material and racks are not claimed.
method: Whirlpool Job Aid W10450109, Global Wash System 2011 Undercounter Dishwashers (KD-14), 98-page PDF, Internet Archive copy; its cover lists WDT710PAY* among the fully integrated door models, and the Internet Archive item page lists it too.
Pages read: 1 (cover), 52 to 53 (overfill assembly), 56 (control removal), 59 and 67 to 68 (component views), 69 to 73 (motor and pump assembly, optical water indicator, diverter motor).
Ratings read from the circuit diagrams on pages 83 and 85 to 87, rendered with pdftoppm at 150 to 300 dpi and cropped for the small print.
Whirlpool's own parts-list PDFs, PartSelect, RepairClinic and Sears PartsDirect were not opened (they refuse automated fetches).

comps.spec: Wash motor in the motor and sump assembly: 1-phase synchronous motor, 120 V 60 Hz, 37 W typical, 45 W maximum
comps.loc: Under the tub, in the motor and sump assembly

comps.spec: Drain motor (drain pump) on the sump: 120 V 60 Hz, 100 W, winding 15 to 25 ohms
comps.loc: On the sump, held by a quarter-turn lock

comps.spec: Heater element in the tub: 8 to 30 ohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 785 W wet and 500 W dry
Fill valve (water inlet solenoid): 890 to 1,090 ohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 6 W
Optical water indicator (OWI) sensor: turbidity and foam drive pins, plus an NTC thermistor of 46 to 52 kilohms at 25 C and 11 to 13 kilohms at 60 C
comps.loc: Sump area, released by a quarter-turn

comps.spec: Hi-limit thermostat (normally closed) in the heater circuit: opens at 97 to 103 C (207 to 217 F)
Diverter valve motor: 1,300 to 1,600 ohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 3 W; the diverter disc is keyed onto its shaft (diverter-valve models)
comps.loc: Under the tub, on the motor and sump assembly

comps.spec: Overfill float switch: the float holds the switch closed in its normal position
Door switch (normally open) feeding the control's door switch sensing input; the diagram marks a 13 V circuit
Dispenser solenoid: 280 to 340 ohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 11 W
Dispenser wax motor (as labelled in the job aid): 1.4 to 2.8 kilohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 10 W
Vent wax motor (as labelled in the job aid): 600 to 1,800 ohms, 120 V 60 Hz, 6 W
Drying fan motor (labelled Fan Motor, 5 V DC): 31 to 41 kilohms, 1 W; measure with the polarity correct and disconnected from the control
Four relays on the electronic control: K1 heater (N), K2 pilot (L1), which also feeds the wash motor, vent and triac loads, K3 heater (L1), K4 motor (N)
Two fuses on the control: F8 for the motor and F9 for small and triac loads. Service check: under 3 ohms is good, over 3 ohms is open
Triacs on the control in the fill, drain, dispenser and diverter circuits
Main electronic control (the diagrams call it Skywalker); the job aid's photo shows a sticker reading S8.02.0 Skywalker and W10352583
comps.loc: In the door, behind the outer door panel

sources.title: Whirlpool Job Aid W10450109, Global Wash System 2011 Undercounter Dishwashers, service manual KD-14 (PDF, Internet Archive copy, 98 pages)
